sloka: स तत्र तेषां रुदतां महात्मनां भुवं च खं चानुनिनादयन् स्वन: ।गुहा गिरीणां च दिशश्च सन्ततं मृदङ्गघोषप्रतिम: प्रशुश्रुवे ॥ २.१०२.४९ ॥
transliteration: sa tatra teṣāṁ rudatāṁ mahātmanāṁ bhuvaṁ ca khaṁ cānuninādayan svana: ।guhā girīṇāṁ ca diśaśca santataṁ mṛdaṅgaghoṣapratima: praśuśruve ॥ 2.102.49 ॥

translations.english: The weeping and the tumult of those magnanimous people made the earth, sky, mountaincaves and all quarters reverberate incessantly like the beating of drums. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्व्युत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundred and second sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
